smoke_test.check: wrapper self-test (python wrapper.py) in the Legwork sandbox, network off

entrypoint: Generate QR codes as PNG or SVG and ASCII art from text using the python-qrcode library

known_answer.derived_from: a version 1 QR code is 21x21 modules by the QR spec; with a 2-module border on each side and 5 px per module the PNG is (21 + 2*2) * 5 = 125 px square ('HELLO WORLD' is 11 alphanumeric characters, within version 1-M's 20) The bare output name qr.png must work too (it crashed before 2026-10-11).
